features.name: Slot lanes + paged KV pool (1M lanes per stage, copy-in/out)
index_k cache not replicated over TP (store once)
index_k cache bf8 instead of bf16
Variable chunk / flexible SP layout (a2a KV write)
MSA SP-local indexer (no K/V/index prefix all-gather)
Shortest-first run to completion (30 s aging)
